Title: [QST] What's the cudf overhead for small dataset?
Description: **What is your question?**

```
import cudf
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

df1 = pd.DataFrame()
dim = 1000
df1["A"] = np.random.randint(0, dim, dim)

df1_cu = cudf.from_pandas(df1)

%%time
df1_cu["A"].sum()
600 µs

%%time
df1["A"].sum()
200 µs
```

cudf seems to have some  overhead for small datasets. Where does it come from? It should not from data transfer as 
df1_cu = cudf.from_pandas(df1) has transferred the data.
